review_evidence: A complete proposition scan found 4,764 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations across 321 current-primary files.

The retained tree spans cryptographic foundations, Fiat–Shamir, program logics, oracle computations, lattice cryptography, hash signatures, verified external-algorithm bridges, and theorem-rich examples such as ElGamal, Schnorr, Pedersen, PIR, Regev, and PRF reductions.
Import roots, tests, widgets, and interoperability modules are intertwined with the formal interfaces and no source-local lossless hard-exclusion class was established in this review.

summary: I inspected all 58 primary files in this review unit. Every file contains substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, lemmas, and proofs — relevant to the VCVio cryptographic verification framework. The files span multiple layers: the GPV hash-and-sign framework with its security reduction (VCVio/CryptoFoundations/GPVHashAndSign/*), quantum oracle programs and their semantics (VCVio/Quantum/*), classical instability calculus for random-oracle databases (VCVio/OracleComp/QueryTracking/Instability/*), lattice-based cryptography (LatticeCrypto/Falcon/Security.lean), and foundational math utilities (ToMathlib/Analysis/*).
